title: Water Damage Mitigation Cleaning Standard: The Vacuumed Floor and Where the Carpet Went
content:
Water Damage Mitigation cleaning standard. Where the carpet went sets the vacuumed floor of the final HEPA vacuuming line:
- when the job carries carpet detach-and-reset lines and pad removal lines, the carpet was rolled back across the room and goes back down, so the vacuumed floor is the square feet on its pad removal lines plus the affected floor area for the carpet's back;
- when it carries carpet removal lines and pad removal lines, carpet and pad left together and the vacuumed floor is the larger of the affected floor area and the square feet on its pad removal lines;
- in any other case no carpet-based change to the vacuumed floor applies.

The lines are the job's own charge lines; the affected floor area is the one mapped on the job.

## Worked figures (hypothetical affected floor area of 560 square feet)
| Lines on the job | Vacuumed floor under this standard |
|---|---|
| carpet detach-and-reset, pad removal of 410 sq ft | 970 square feet |
| carpet removal, pad removal of 610 sq ft | 610 square feet |
| carpet removal, pad removal of 430 sq ft | 560 square feet |
| carpet removal only, no pad removal | no carpet-based change |
